Fox Valley Bicycle & Ski Club Tuesday Trail Ride

St. Charles, IL · Road

Fox Valley Bicycle & Ski Club Tuesday Trail Ride is a road group ride in St. Charles, IL. It rolls every Tuesday at 5:30 pm from James O Breen Community Park, east-side lot off Peck Rd.

For visitors

Registration is required but free for everyone. Bring front and rear lights. The ride goes west for about an hour and returns.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 12-14 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Fox Valley Bicycle & Ski Club Tuesday Trail Ride group ride

A Tuesday-evening trail ride west from St. Charles: 20 to 25 miles at 12 to 14 mph, one hour out and back. The club says all rides except its Advanced ones are no drop.
